## User / research value

Determine whether the Computational Finance of Intelligence bridge and three
paper tracks have defensible research space before implementation begins.
Produce a dated, inspectable map from proposed claims to the closest primary
literature, unresolved novelty risks, and concrete scope recommendations.

## Problem

The current paper questions are approved program proposals, not established
novel contributions. Implementation would be premature without a reproducible
primary-source review spanning stochastic belief models, metareasoning and
optimal stopping, linguistic framing and probabilistic coherence, and
human/machine forecast aggregation and prediction markets.

## Scope

### In scope

- Record the search date, query families, databases, inclusion/exclusion rules,
  and citation verification procedure.
- Map each proposed contribution to foundational and current primary sources.
- Identify the nearest competing work and explain exact overlap and remaining
  research space.
- Separate established background, supported inference, proposal, and unknown.
- Assign each track a provisional disposition: keep, narrow, merge, or stop.
- Record revalidation dates and reviewer checks.

### Out of scope

- Dataset acquisition, license acceptance, participant interaction, or data
  transformation.
- Model selection, API use, experiments, pilots, simulations, or cloud work.
- Changing approved primary questions without Director approval.
- Selecting a publication venue or presenting novelty as established.
- Treating search snippets, blogs, vendor claims, or generated prose as primary
  research evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A controlled, dated matrix covers the shared bridge and all three papers.
- [ ] The search protocol is reproducible and states its limits.
- [ ] Evidentiary entries link to inspectable primary papers, proceedings,
  standards, or official records; secondary sources are discovery-only.
- [ ] Each proposed claim has closest-work, overlap, gap, risk, and disposition
  fields.
- [ ] Conflicting evidence and contribution-collapsing work are visible rather
  than silently omitted.
- [ ] Novelty remains explicitly provisional pending independent G1 review.
- [ ] The technical reference register records the new volatile assumptions and
  revalidation boundary.
- [ ] Foundation/program validators and relevant document tests pass.

## Verification plan

```text
python scripts/validate_foundation.py
python scripts/validate_program.py
python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/docs
python -m ruff check scripts/validate_program.py tests/test_program_control.py
git diff --check
```

## Security / privacy / licensing / cost

- Literature access only; no human or model data is acquired.
- No employer, customer, proprietary, private, or personal material.
- No paid API, cloud resource, model inference, or external write is authorized.
- Bibliographic facts and short paraphrases are recorded; copyrighted papers
  are linked rather than copied into the repository.

## Stop conditions

- A primary source cannot be inspected or its identity cannot be verified.
- A competing paper substantially collapses a proposed contribution.
- A material claim depends only on secondary commentary or vendor marketing.
- The review indicates that an approved primary question must change.

Record the issue and request Director direction rather than silently reframing
the program.
